ModDescription: Pick which sigil(s) Transmarvel gives you. Unique sigils: War Elemental+, Untouchable+, Flight over Fight+, Potent Greens+, Auto Potion+, Roll of the Die+, the echo sigils, Alpha/Beta/Gamma+, the Celestials, Divergence, Fatebreaker, plus the one-of-a-kind event sigils (Immortal Shell, In a Pinch, Sumo Force, the crab set; the game blocks duplicates of most of these, the app warns you). Character sigils: the three + sigils and the Awakening+ of every character. Transmarvel sigils: the 26 standard V+ sigils of the vanilla pool. For sigils with a random 2nd trait you can pin the trait you want (always a natural roll for that sigil). With several picks set, Transmarvel splits evenly between them. Or turn on gacha mode: check every sigil you want in the pool and Transmarvel rolls randomly among them, 2nd traits stay random. Gacha mode can also exclude traits from the random 2nd-trait roll (this filter applies to every sigil that rolls a random 2nd trait, not only Transmarvel ones). By default it also skips wrightstones so every Transmarvel is a sigil (can be turned off in the GUI). Note: some unique picks (marked in the GUI) are real game sigils that the vanilla Transmarvel pool does not contain; this mod adds them to it. Set it up with the included GBFRER Sigil Picker.exe. See README.txt.
